serverInfo.name: jamestannahill-com
serverInfo.title: James Tannahill Site MCP Server
serverInfo.description: Read-only MCP tools over the published content of jamestannahill.com: site search, venture records, FAQ answers and contact details.

tools.name: search_site
tools.title: Search the site
tools.description: Search jamestannahill.com across pages, ventures and FAQs. Returns ranked matches with their URLs. Use this first when you do not already know which page answers the question.

query.description: Free-text query, e.g. "private equity valuation levers" or "SigScan".

tools.name: list_ventures
tools.title: List ventures
tools.description: List the ventures and platforms James Tannahill founded, leads or advises, with each one's description, external website and on-site page.

tools.name: get_venture
tools.title: Get one venture
tools.description: Retrieve the full record for one venture by its slug. Call list_ventures first if you do not know the slug.

tools.name: get_faq_answer
tools.title: Answer a pre-engagement question
tools.description: Answer a pre-engagement question from the published FAQ on value engineering, valuation levers, exit multiples, company fit, applied AI in private equity, and how to make contact.

question.description: The question, in your own words.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.title: Get contact details
tools.description: Get how to reach James Tannahill: contact form, email addresses, and the machine-readable documents describing him and the site.

resources.name: agent-index
resources.title: Site corpus
resources.description: Every page, venture and FAQ on jamestannahill.com as one JSON document.

resources.name: llms-txt
resources.title: LLM guidance index
resources.description: Short-form site index written for language models.

resources.name: llms-full-txt
resources.title: Full LLM guidance
resources.description: Entity data, citable facts, professional background and access policy.

prompts.name: brief_on_james
prompts.title: Brief me on James Tannahill
prompts.description: A short, sourced briefing on who James Tannahill is and what he runs.

prompts.name: venture_brief
prompts.title: Brief on one venture
prompts.description: A short briefing on a single venture, drawn from its published page.
